description: Turns sixteen MIDI notes into separate gates, one per cell of the grid, for driving drum voices from a pad controller

outputs.text: 10V while the note printed in the cell above is held; the menu can make it a 1ms trigger at each press instead, or scale the voltage by velocity or aftertouch

notes: nothing comes out until a MIDI device is chosen and each cell has been given a note
click a cell and play a note on the MIDI device to give that cell the note it answers to
the driver, device and channel are picked by left-clicking the three lines of the display, each of which opens a menu of its own; none of them is on the panel's right-click menu
menu: Output type — Gates, held for as long as the note is down, or Triggers, a 1ms pulse at each press
Output amplitude — how high a gate goes: 10V, Velocity or Aftertouch
MPE mode — gives each of the sixteen MIDI channels its own polyphony channel on every output
Reset MIDI (Panic) — drops every held note and returns the outputs to rest
